cohortInput.allocationBoundary: Final retained regular-file allocation after normal provider exit, not peak: only this run's delta and native-bee directories. Shared fixture, tools, source export, receipts, measurement copies and filesystem directory metadata are excluded.

remainingCostEvidence.flushExplanation: Kernel root flush and the post-context-drain flush both reach native payloads. The latter cannot be omitted merely by assuming no late paging writes.
remainingCostEvidence.nativeCreateStructure: Each new native file has a durable journal namespace create, three sidecar JSON publications, and an empty native payload flush. Those control/creation flush durations are not separately measured.
otherRemainingWork: native handle identity checks and per-write timestamps
remainingCostEvidence.nextDesignCandidate: Put native association in the same authoritative namespace mutation/replay record to reduce cross-store intents, with a new explicit ownership/recovery/accounting design. No estimated speedup.
